capabilities: Sync a vault two-way with a MEGA.nz folder using a three-way merge
Auto-merge conflicting text files or keep conflict copies
Filter synced files with globs, regexes, file-type whitelists and size limits
Simulate a sync with dry-run and abort guards before changes apply
Review sync history via a persisted sync report and live log view
extras: Mobile support is marked experimental, with a known TLS cipher-suite issue on some devices. The MEGA password is stored in plaintext in data.json unless the optional AES-256-GCM encryption setting is enabled; the README warns not to commit data.json publicly. Installable via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault synchronized with a MEGA.nz account, so users of that cloud service had no direct sync option.

relations.evidence: Two-way sync between your Obsidian vault and your MEGA.nz cloud, inspired by Remotely Save.
Two-way sync between your Obsidian vault and a folder on your MEGA.nz account.

summary: Two-way sync between an Obsidian vault and a MEGA.nz cloud folder, using three-way merge, conflict auto-merge for text notes, and granular filters.
